machine_head.qualification: Analyst active bench-service estimate with configured provisional eligibility; no measured or published labor-time standard
machine_head.rationale: Twenty minutes of active prepared-bench resurfacing work is a planning allowance, not a measured shop rate. Service entry E06 supports conditional resurfacing consideration, not the duration. Eligibility, material removal and resulting flatness are explicitly configured benchmark values; head-height, cam-holder and full physical suitability remain separately unresolved. The allowance excludes queue, transport and unattended elapsed time. Every attempted request, including refusal, pays this base under the charging policy.

measure.qualification: Analyst per-tool-operation estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
measure.rationale: Procedural sources support the operation, not the duration. One call handles one body or one instrument reading; estimates exclude supplied bench setup.

parts_bin.qualification: Analyst stock-selection planning estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
parts_bin.rationale: One enumeration/selection attempt in supplied stock, using the existing inspect/replace 30-second planning unit. Procedural citations support choosing a compatible new part, not this duration. Existing replace performs the transfer; no extra retrieval charge is added.

prepare_condition.qualification: Analyst named-condition preparation planning estimate; provisional benchmark state, no physical credit
prepare_condition.rationale: One explicit attempt to prepare a named benchmark condition uses the existing remove/install 30-second planning unit. Procedural citations support preparation, not this duration. This is a uniform metadata-level allowance, not a measured duration for arbitrary draining, lifting or isolation work; the actual condition and evidence basis remain labelled.

release_attachment.qualification: Analyst attachment-release planning estimate; provisional source-policy transition, no physical release credit
release_attachment.rationale: One explicit source-defined attachment-release attempt uses the existing remove 30-second planning unit. Its named source precondition must be satisfied before the recorded state changes. The allowance estimates one represented operation, not a physical joint law or a published labor standard. Subsequent body removal is a separate charged attempt.

remove.qualification: Analyst per-tool-operation estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
remove.rationale: Procedural sources support the operation, not the duration. One call handles one body or one instrument reading; estimates exclude supplied bench setup.

replace.qualification: Analyst per-tool-operation estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
replace.rationale: Procedural sources support the operation, not the duration. One call handles one body or one instrument reading; estimates exclude supplied bench setup.

restore_attachment.qualification: Analyst attachment-restoration planning estimate; provisional benchmark transition, no physical tightening credit
restore_attachment.rationale: One explicit attempt to restore a previously released attachment uses the existing install 30-second planning unit. Restoring a recorded state does not supply torque, seal, connection or physical fit specifications. Applicable source/service checks remain separate; body installation and applicable torque operations are separately charged.

search_service_info.qualification: Analyst per-tool-operation estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
search_service_info.rationale: Procedural sources support the operation, not the duration. One call handles one body or one instrument reading; estimates exclude supplied bench setup.

set_timing.qualification: Analyst TDC/mark-setting planning estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
set_timing.rationale: One timing-setting attempt rotates/aligns the represented phases to the configured cylinder-one compression-TDC datum, using the existing check_timing 120-second planning unit. Service entry E10 supports setting/rechecking the marks, not this duration. Later check_timing is a separate verification action. The phase convention is a benchmark convention, not a physical engine simulation.

tension_belt.qualification: Analyst belt-tensioning planning estimate; discrete benchmark status and no invented numeric tension
tension_belt.rationale: One belt-tensioning attempt uses the existing check_timing 120-second planning unit. Service entry E10 supports the timing-restoration task, not the duration or a numeric tension. The environment records a labelled discrete tensioned state; this is not a physical belt-tension measurement.

torque.qualification: Analyst per-tool-operation estimate; no published elapsed-time standard
torque.rationale: Per fastener application estimate, derived from the side review planning arithmetic. Tightening and loosening are charged per application; no whole-job flat-rate claim.

scope: Prepared benchmark bench; every action attempt including environmental refusal is charged. Cited procedures support the task, not the analyst durations. Active service estimates exclude queue/transport/unattended elapsed time. Configured machining eligibility and discrete belt tension are provisional benchmark conditions, not physical repair admission. Wall time and tokens are separate.
source_identity_scope: Neutral records retain historical labor source-record and optional document hashes. References, titles and source locators are not copied.
